source.text: לְדָוִ֗ד בְּשַׁנּוֹת֣וֹ אֶת־טַ֭עְמוֹ לִפְנֵ֣י אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ וַֽ֝יְגָרֲשֵׁ֗הוּ וַיֵּלַֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Of David, when he changed his sense before Abimelech, and he drove him out, and he went.

en.L: Of David, when he changed his sense before Abimelech, who drove him out, and he went away.
en.B: Of David, when he pretended to be insane in front of Abimelech, who drove him away, and he left.
en.R: By David, from the time he acted as if he had lost his mind in front of Abimelech. Abimelech sent him away, and David left.

fr.L: De David, quand il changea son bon sens devant Abimélek, qui le chassa, et il s’en alla.
fr.B: De David, quand il fit semblant d’être fou devant Abimélek, qui le renvoya, et il partit.
fr.R: Par David, à l’époque où il a fait comme s’il avait perdu la raison devant Abimélek. Abimélek l’a renvoyé, et David est parti.

sw.L: Ya Daudi, alipobadilisha akili yake mbele ya Abimeleki, aliyemfukuza, naye akaenda zake.
sw.B: Ya Daudi, alipojifanya kichaa mbele ya Abimeleki, aliyemfukuza, naye akaondoka.
sw.R: Ya Daudi, wakati alipojifanya kana kwamba amerukwa na akili mbele ya Abimeleki. Abimeleki alimfukuza, na Daudi akaondoka.

es.L: De David, cuando cambió su juicio delante de Abimelec, quien lo echó, y él se fue.
es.B: De David, cuando se fingió loco delante de Abimelec, quien lo expulsó, y él se marchó.
es.R: Escrito por David, de cuando hizo como si hubiera perdido la razón delante de Abimelec. Abimelec lo echó, y David se fue.

vi.L: Của Đa-vít, khi ông đổi cách cư xử trước mặt A-bi-mê-léc, là người đã đuổi ông đi, và ông bỏ đi.
vi.B: Của Đa-vít, khi ông giả điên trước mặt A-bi-mê-léc, là người đã đuổi ông đi, và ông ra đi.
vi.R: Của Đa-vít, viết vào lúc ông giả làm người mất trí trước mặt A-bi-mê-léc. A-bi-mê-léc đuổi ông đi, và Đa-vít ra đi.

decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

When David fled from Saul to Gath, he was afraid of its king and acted like a madman, and the king sent him away (1 Samuel 21; the psalm's title says "drove him out"). Psalm 56:1 also refers to David in Gath.

decisions.choice: Abimelech: probably a royal name or title
decisions.reason: In 1 Samuel the king of Gath is called Achish. Abimelech, "my father is king", is the name of Philistine kings of Gerar in Genesis 20 and 26, and may have been used as a title for such kings. Why the title uses it here is not known.

decisions.choice: changed his sense: pretended to be mad
decisions.reason: Literally he "changed his taste", that is his judgment or behavior; 1 Samuel 21 uses the same words. The word for sense (ta'am) comes from the verb "taste" used in verse 9.
Readable names who drove whom away.

decisions.choice: passé simple for the event the title recalls at Literal and Balanced ("il changea", "qui le chassa"); passé composé at Readable
decisions.reason: The title tells a past event as narrative, so it follows the French style guide’s tenses for narrative; the psalm itself is speech and keeps the tenses of speech.

decisions.choice: "đổi cách cư xử" (changed his behavior) at Literal; "giả điên" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says he changed his "sense" or good judgment, meaning he pretended to be mad (see the meaning decision); a word-for-word Vietnamese phrase would not be understood, so Literal says he changed how he behaved, and the other levels say what he did.

source.text: אֲבָרֲכָ֣ה אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה בְּכָל־עֵ֑ת תָּ֝מִ֗יד תְּֽהִלָּת֥וֹ בְּפִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: I will bless YHWH at every time; continually his praise [is] in my mouth.

en.L: I will bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at all times; continually {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} praise [will be] in my mouth.
en.B: I will bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in every season; praise of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} will never leave my mouth.
en.R: I will praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} all the time. I will always be speaking words of praise to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: Je bénirai {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} en tout temps ; continuellement {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} louange [sera] dans ma bouche.
fr.B: Je bénirai {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} en toute saison ; {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} louange ne quittera jamais ma bouche.
fr.R: Je louerai {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} tout le temps. Je dirai toujours des paroles de louange pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Nitambariki {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kila wakati; daima sifa {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} [zitakuwa] kinywani mwangu.
sw.B: Nitambariki {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika kila kipindi; sifa {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} hazitaondoka kinywani mwangu kamwe.
sw.R: Nitamsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wakati wote. Kila mara nitakuwa nikisema maneno ya kumsifu.

es.L: Bendeciré {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en todo tiempo; continuamente {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} alabanza [estará] en mi boca.
es.B: Bendeciré {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en toda circunstancia; {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} alabanza nunca se apartará de mi boca.
es.R: Alabaré {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} todo el tiempo. Siempre estaré diciendo palabras de alabanza para {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

vi.L: Tôi sẽ chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mọi lúc; lời ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} luôn luôn [ở] trong miệng tôi.
vi.B: Tôi sẽ chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trong mọi thời kỳ; lời ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không bao giờ rời khỏi miệng tôi.
vi.R: Tôi sẽ ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mọi lúc. Miệng tôi sẽ luôn nói lời ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.reason: From this verse to verse 22 each verse begins with the next letter of the Hebrew alphabet (one letter, waw, is missing), and verse 23 adds one more line, as Psalm 25 does. The form shows the poem was crafted with care and helps it to be learned.

decisions.choice: bless the LORD: praise him, speak well of him
decisions.reason: When people bless God (barak) they do not give him anything; they honor and thank him (103:1).
Readable gives the sense of blessing God (m2).

source.text: בַּ֭יהוָה תִּתְהַלֵּ֣ל נַפְשִׁ֑י יִשְׁמְע֖וּ עֲנָוִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָֽחוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: In YHWH my soul will boast; let [the] humble hear and be glad.

en.L: In {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my soul will boast; let [the] humble hear and be glad.
en.B: I will make my boast in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; let the humble hear it and rejoice.
en.R: I will boast about {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. People who are humble will hear it and be glad.

fr.L: En {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon âme se glorifiera ; que [les] humbles entendent et se réjouissent.
fr.B: Je ferai {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ma fierté ; que les humbles l’entendent et se réjouissent.
fr.R: Je dirai avec fierté ce que fait {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Les gens humbles l’entendront et seront heureux.

sw.L: Katika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} nafsi yangu itajisifu; wanyonge wasikie na kufurahi.
sw.B: Nitajivuna katika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; wanyonge walisikie hilo na kufurahi.
sw.R: Nitajivuna kwa sababu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Watu wanyenyekevu watasikia na kufurahi.

es.L: En {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se gloriará mi alma; que oigan [los] humildes y se alegren.
es.B: Me gloriaré en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; que lo oigan los humildes y se alegren.
es.R: Hablaré con orgullo de {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Las personas humildes lo oirán y se alegrarán.

vi.L: Trong {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} linh hồn tôi sẽ khoe mình; nguyện [những người] khiêm nhường nghe và vui mừng.
vi.B: Tôi sẽ lấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm điều hãnh diện của mình; nguyện những người khiêm nhường nghe điều ấy và vui mừng.
vi.R: Tôi sẽ hãnh diện nói về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Những người khiêm nhường sẽ nghe và vui mừng.

decisions.choice: boast: glory in, be proud of
decisions.reason: To boast in the LORD is to take pride in him and not in oneself (Jeremiah 9 makes the same point).

decisions.choice: the humble: the lowly who depend on God
decisions.reason: The word ('anawim) is used for the poor and lowly who look to the LORD (9:13; 10:17).
"My soul" (nefesh) is the speaker himself.

source.text: גַּדְּל֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה אִתִּ֑י וּנְרוֹמְמָ֖ה שְׁמ֣וֹ יַחְדָּֽו׃

records.literal_gloss: Magnify YHWH with me, and let us exalt his name together.

en.L: Magnify {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with me, and let us exalt {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name together.
en.B: Join me in telling how great {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is; let us lift high {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name together.
en.R: Come and praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with me. Let us all honor {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name together.

fr.L: Magnifiez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avec moi, et exaltons ensemble {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.
fr.B: Venez avec moi dire combien {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand ; élevons ensemble {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom bien haut.
fr.R: Venez louer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avec moi. Honorons tous ensemble {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.

sw.L: Mtukuzeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} pamoja nami, na tuliinue jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} pamoja.
sw.B: Ungana nami kusema jinsi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyo mkuu; tuliinue jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} juu pamoja.
sw.R: Njooni mmsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} pamoja nami. Sisi sote tuliheshimu jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} pamoja.

es.L: {{plural_you:Engrandezcan|Engrandeced}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} conmigo, y exaltemos juntos {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.
es.B: {{plural_you:Únanse|Uníos}} a mí para contar lo grande que es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; ensalcemos juntos {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.
es.R: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}} y {{plural_you:alaben|alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} conmigo. Honremos todos juntos {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.

vi.L: Hãy cùng tôi tôn vinh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và chúng ta hãy cùng nhau tôn cao danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Hãy cùng tôi nói lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vĩ đại biết bao; chúng ta hãy cùng nhau tôn cao danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Hãy đến cùng tôi ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Chúng ta hãy cùng nhau tôn kính danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.reason: The verb (giddel) means to make great, here by saying how great he is.
As in 33:21, the name stands for the LORD as he has made himself known.

source.text: דָּרַ֣שְׁתִּי אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה וְעָנָ֑נִי וּמִכָּל־מְ֝גוּרוֹתַ֗י הִצִּילָֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: I sought YHWH, and he answered me, and from all my fears he delivered me.

en.L: I sought {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} answered me, and from all my fears {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} delivered me.
en.B: I went looking for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave me an answer and rescued me from everything I dreaded.
en.R: I asked {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for help, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} answered me. He saved me from everything that made me afraid.

fr.L: J’ai cherché {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a répondu, et de toutes mes frayeurs {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a délivré.
fr.B: Je suis allé chercher {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a répondu et m’a délivré de tout ce que je redoutais.
fr.R: J’ai demandé de l’aide {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a répondu. Il m’a sauvé de tout ce qui me faisait peur.

sw.L: Nilimtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akanijibu, na kutoka katika hofu zangu zote akaniokoa.
sw.B: Nilikwenda kumtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; akanipa jibu na kuniokoa kutoka katika kila kitu nilichokihofia.
sw.R: Nilimwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} msaada, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akanijibu. Aliniokoa kutoka katika kila kitu kilichonitisha.

es.L: Busqué {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me respondió, y de todos mis temores {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me libró.
es.B: Fui en busca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me dio respuesta y me rescató de todo lo que me espantaba.
es.R: Le pedí ayuda {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me respondió. Me salvó de todo lo que me daba miedo.

vi.L: Tôi đã tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đáp lời tôi, và khỏi mọi nỗi sợ hãi của tôi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giải cứu tôi.
vi.B: Tôi đã đi tìm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đáp lời tôi và giải cứu tôi khỏi mọi điều tôi kinh sợ.
vi.R: Tôi xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giúp đỡ, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trả lời tôi. Ngài cứu tôi khỏi mọi điều làm tôi sợ hãi.

decisions.choice: sought: turned to him for help
decisions.reason: To seek (darash) the LORD is to go to him and ask (9:11).

decisions.choice: my fears: the things I feared
decisions.reason: The word (megurot) is the dangers that caused his fear.

source.text: הִבִּ֣יטוּ אֵלָ֣יו וְנָהָ֑רוּ וּ֝פְנֵיהֶ֗ם אַל־יֶחְפָּֽרוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: They looked to him and were radiant, and their faces let them not be ashamed.

en.L: They looked to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and were radiant, and their faces will not be put to shame.
en.B: Those who look to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} glow with joy, and no shame will darken their faces.
en.R: People who look to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} for help are bright with joy. They will never hang their heads in shame.

fr.L: Ils ont regardé vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} et ont été radieux, et leurs visages ne seront pas couverts de honte.
fr.B: Ceux qui regardent vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} rayonnent de joie, et la honte n’assombrira pas leur visage.
fr.R: Ceux qui regardent vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} pour avoir de l’aide sont lumineux de joie. Ils ne baisseront jamais la tête de honte.

sw.L: Walimtazama {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} wakang'aa, na nyuso zao hazitaaibishwa.
sw.B: Wale wanaomtazama {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} hung'aa kwa furaha, wala aibu haitazitia giza nyuso zao.
sw.R: Watu wanaomtazama {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ili awasaidie hung'aa kwa furaha. Hawatainamisha vichwa vyao kwa aibu kamwe.

es.L: Miraron a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y quedaron radiantes, y sus rostros no serán avergonzados.
es.B: Los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} miran resplandecen de alegría, y ninguna vergüenza oscurecerá su rostro.
es.R: Las personas que acuden a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en busca de ayuda brillan de alegría. Nunca bajarán la cabeza avergonzadas.

vi.L: Họ đã nhìn lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và được rạng rỡ, và mặt họ sẽ không bị hổ thẹn.
vi.B: Những ai nhìn lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đều rạng ngời vui mừng, và sự hổ thẹn sẽ không làm tối sầm mặt họ.
vi.R: Những người nhìn lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để được giúp đỡ đều rạng rỡ vui mừng. Họ sẽ không bao giờ phải cúi mặt vì xấu hổ.

alternatives: Look to him and be radiant ... your faces (some ancient translations)
decisions.reason: Some ancient translations read the verbs as commands and "your faces", calling the hearers to look to God, which suits verses 4 and 9. The Hebrew text, which describes those who looked to him, is followed.
The verb (nahar) is used of a face that lights up with joy (Isaiah 60:5).
Shame on the face is the disgrace of a hope that failed (25:3).
The past forms describe what is always true of those who look to him; Balanced and Readable use the present.

source.text: זֶ֤ה עָנִ֣י קָ֭רָא וַיהוָ֣ה שָׁמֵ֑עַ וּמִכָּל־צָ֝רוֹתָ֗יו הוֹשִׁיעֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: This poor [man] called, and YHWH heard, and from all his troubles he saved him.

en.L: This poor [man] called, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} heard, and saved him from all his troubles.
en.B: Here was a poor man who cried out; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} heard and rescued him from every one of his troubles.
en.R: This poor man cried out for help, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} heard him. He rescued him from every trouble he had.

fr.L: Ce pauvre a appelé, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a entendu, et l’a sauvé de toutes ses détresses.
fr.B: Voici un pauvre qui a crié ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a entendu et l’a délivré de chacune de ses détresses.
fr.R: Ce pauvre a crié au secours, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a entendu. Il l’a délivré de tous ses malheurs.

sw.L: Huyu maskini aliita, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasikia, akamwokoa katika taabu zake zote.
sw.B: Hapa palikuwa na mnyonge aliyelia; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasikia, akamwokoa katika kila taabu yake.
sw.R: Mtu huyu maskini alilia aombe msaada, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamsikia. Alimwokoa katika kila taabu aliyokuwa nayo.

es.L: Este pobre clamó, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [lo] oyó, y lo salvó de todas sus angustias.
es.B: Aquí había un pobre que clamó; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo oyó y lo rescató de cada una de sus angustias.
es.R: Este pobre pidió ayuda a gritos, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo oyó. Lo rescató de todos los problemas que tenía.

vi.L: Người nghèo khổ này đã kêu cầu, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã nghe, và đã cứu người khỏi mọi hoạn nạn của người.
vi.B: Đây là một người khốn khổ đã kêu cầu; {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nghe và giải cứu người khỏi mọi hoạn nạn.
vi.R: Người nghèo khổ này đã kêu cứu, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã nghe người. Ngài giải cứu người khỏi mọi hoạn nạn người gặp.

decisions.choice: This poor man: the psalmist himself
decisions.reason: The words point to someone present, most naturally the speaker, who tells his own story as an example (verse 5). They also invite every poor person to see themselves in him.
The word ('ani) is used for the needy and oppressed, who have no one but God.
The verb (yasha') means to rescue from danger.
The word means afflicted and helpless, not only short of money (see the meaning decision); the terms note's "người khốn khổ" says that, and "nghèo khổ" joins both senses. "kẻ" would sound scornful.

source.text: חֹנֶ֤ה מַלְאַךְ־יְהוָ֓ה סָ֘בִ֤יב לִֽירֵאָ֗יו וַֽיְחַלְּצֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] angel of YHWH encamps around those who fear him, and he rescues them.

en.L: The angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} encamps around those who fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and rescues them.
en.B: The angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} pitches camp all around the people who fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and sets them free.
en.R: The angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is like an army camped around people who honor {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. The angel keeps them safe.

fr.L: L’ange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} campe autour de ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craignent, et les délivre.
fr.B: L’ange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} dresse son camp tout autour de ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craignent, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les libère.
fr.R: L’ange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est comme une armée qui campe autour de ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}honorent. L’ange les garde en sécurité.

sw.L: Malaika wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hupiga kambi kuwazunguka wale wanaomcha, na kuwaokoa.
sw.B: Malaika wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hupiga kambi pande zote za watu wanaomcha, na kuwaweka huru.
sw.R: Malaika wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni kama jeshi lililopiga kambi kuwazunguka watu wanaomheshimu. Malaika huyo huwalinda salama.

es.L: El ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} acampa alrededor de los que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} temen, y los rescata.
es.B: El ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} pone su campamento alrededor de la gente que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} teme, y la pone en libertad.
es.R: El ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} es como un ejército acampado alrededor de las personas que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} honran. El ángel las mantiene a salvo.

vi.L: Thiên sứ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đóng trại chung quanh những người kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và giải cứu họ.
vi.B: Thiên sứ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dựng trại vây quanh những người kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và giải thoát họ.
vi.R: Thiên sứ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} như một đạo quân đóng trại chung quanh những người tôn kính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Thiên sứ giữ họ được an toàn.

decisions.choice: the angel of the LORD: the LORD's messenger who acts for him
decisions.reason: The angel of the LORD speaks and acts with the LORD's own authority (Genesis 16:7-13; Exodus 3:2-6). In 35:5-6 he drives the enemy away.

decisions.choice: encamps around: guards like an army
decisions.reason: The picture is of an army camped around a city to protect it (2 Kings 6:17).
The verb (chalats) means to pull out or set free.
As in 33:18.

source.text: טַעֲמ֣וּ וּ֭רְאוּ כִּי־ט֣וֹב יְהוָ֑ה אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י הַ֝גֶּ֗בֶר יֶחֱסֶה־בּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Taste and see that good [is] YHWH; how blessed [is] the man [who] takes refuge in him.

en.L: Taste and see that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] good; how blessed [is] {{gender:the one|the man}} who takes refuge in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}!
en.B: Taste and see how good {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is! How blessed is {{gender:the person|the man}} who makes {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} {{gender:their|his}} refuge!
en.R: Try {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for yourselves, and you will find out how good {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is. Life is truly good for people who run to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} for safety.

fr.L: Goûtez et voyez que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] bon ; heureux {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}} qui se réfugie en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} !
fr.B: Goûtez et voyez combien {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est bon ! Heureux celui qui fait de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} son refuge !
fr.R: Faites vous-mêmes l’expérience {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et vous découvrirez combien {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est bon. Quel bonheur pour ceux qui courent vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} pour être à l’abri !

sw.L: Onjeni na mwone kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mwema; heri mtu anayemkimbilia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}!
sw.B: Onjeni mwone jinsi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyo mwema! Ana heri kweli mtu anayemfanya {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} kuwa kimbilio lake!
sw.R: Mjaribuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ninyi wenyewe, nanyi mtagundua jinsi alivyo mwema. Maisha ni mema kweli kwa watu wanaomkimbilia ili wawe salama.

es.L: {{plural_you:Prueben|Probad}} y {{plural_you:vean|ved}} que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] bueno; ¡{{gender:dichosa la persona|dichoso el hombre}} que se refugia en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}!
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Saboreen|Saboread}} y {{plural_you:comprueben|comprobad}} lo bueno que es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! ¡Qué {{gender:dichosa es la persona|dichoso es el hombre}} que hace de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} su refugio!
es.R: {{plural_you:Comprueben|Comprobad}} {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} mismos cómo es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y {{plural_you:descubrirán|descubriréis}} lo bueno que es {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Las personas que corren a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} para estar a salvo son verdaderamente felices.

vi.L: Hãy nếm và thấy rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] tốt lành; phước thay người ẩn náu nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!
vi.B: Hãy nếm thử và xem {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tốt lành biết bao! Phước hạnh thay người lấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm nơi ẩn náu!
vi.R: Hãy tự mình nếm thử {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, rồi anh chị em sẽ biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tốt lành dường nào. Thật hạnh phúc cho những người chạy đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để được an toàn.

decisions.choice: taste and see: find out by experience
decisions.reason: To taste is to try something and judge it; the word recalls the title, where David "changed his taste" (verse 1). 1 Peter 2:3 takes up these words.
The word (gever) is a man, here any person who takes refuge in the LORD.
As in 2:12.

decisions.choice: the one (L), the person (B); "the man" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The word means anyone (m2). Readable says "people".
Readable says what the picture means (m1).

decisions.choice: "celui qui" with no gender setting at Balanced, where the English has "the person" with "the man" as the alternative
decisions.reason: French "celui qui" already means anyone, so Balanced needs no setting; Literal keeps the noun ("l’être humain", alternative "l’homme") for geber, as the English Literal does.

decisions.choice: dichosa la persona (L); dichosa es la persona (B), with "dichoso el hombre" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "the man" means anyone (see the meaning decision). As in English, the default is inclusive, and the gender setting takes in the whole phrase so that "dichosa" agrees with "la persona" and "dichoso" with "el hombre".

source.text: יְר֣אוּ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה קְדֹשָׁ֑יו כִּי־אֵ֥ין מַ֝חְס֗וֹר לִירֵאָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Fear YHWH, his holy ones, for there is no lack for those who fear him.

en.L: Fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, [you] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy ones, for there is no lack for those who fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all you {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people set apart; nothing is missing for those who fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: All you people who belong to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, honor {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}! People who honor {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} will have everything they need.

fr.L: Craignez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, [vous] {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} saints, car rien ne manque à ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craignent.
fr.B: Craignez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, vous tous qui êtes {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple mis à part ; rien ne manque à ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craignent.
fr.R: Vous tous qui appartenez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, honorez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ! Ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}honorent auront tout ce dont ils ont besoin.

sw.L: Mcheni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, enyi watakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, kwa maana hakuna upungufu kwa wale wanaomcha.
sw.B: Mcheni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninyi nyote watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mliotengwa; hakuna kinachowapungukia wale wanaomcha.
sw.R: Ninyi nyote mlio watu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mheshimuni! Watu wanaomheshimu watakuwa na kila kitu wanachohitaji.

es.L: {{plural_you:Teman|Temed}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} santos, porque nada les falta a los que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} temen.
es.B: {{plural_you:Teman|Temed}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo apartado para {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; nada les falta a los que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} temen.
es.R: Todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los que {{plural_you:pertenecen|pertenecéis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, ¡{{plural_you:hónrenlo|honradlo}}! Los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} honran tendrán todo lo que necesitan.

vi.L: Hãy kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi các thánh đồ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì những người kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không thiếu thốn gì.
vi.B: Hỡi tất cả dân thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hãy kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; những người kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không thiếu thứ gì.
vi.R: Hỡi tất cả những người thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hãy tôn kính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! Những người tôn kính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ có đủ mọi điều họ cần.

decisions.reason: Holy ones (qedoshim) usually means angels, but here it is his people, set apart for him (Leviticus 19:2; Deuteronomy 33:3).

decisions.choice: no lack: they will not go without what they need
decisions.reason: Compare 23:1. Verse 11 says the same about every good thing.
As in 33:18.

source.text: כְּ֭פִירִים רָשׁ֣וּ וְרָעֵ֑בוּ וְדֹרְשֵׁ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה לֹא־יַחְסְר֥וּ כָל־טֽוֹב׃

records.literal_gloss: Young lions lack and are hungry, but those seeking YHWH do not lack any good.

en.L: Young lions lack and are hungry, but those who seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} do not lack any good [thing].
en.B: Even young lions can go short and feel hunger, but those who seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will never be without anything good.
en.R: Even strong young lions sometimes have nothing and go hungry. But people who look to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will have every good thing they need.

fr.L: Les lionceaux manquent [de tout] et ont faim, mais ceux qui cherchent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne manquent d’aucun bien.
fr.B: Même les jeunes lions peuvent manquer de tout et souffrir de la faim, mais ceux qui cherchent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne seront jamais privés de rien de bon.
fr.R: Même les jeunes lions, si forts, n’ont parfois rien et ont faim. Mais ceux qui se tournent vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} auront toutes les bonnes choses dont ils ont besoin.

sw.L: Simba wachanga hupungukiwa na kuona njaa, lakini wale wanaomtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hawakosi kitu chochote chema.
sw.B: Hata simba wachanga huweza kupungukiwa na kuona njaa, lakini wale wanaomtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hawatakosa kitu chochote kizuri.
sw.R: Hata simba wachanga wenye nguvu wakati mwingine hukosa kitu na kuona njaa. Lakini watu wanaomtegemea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} watakuwa na kila kitu kizuri wanachohitaji.

es.L: Los leoncillos pasan necesidad y tienen hambre, pero a los que buscan {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} no les falta ningún bien.
es.B: Hasta los leones jóvenes pueden pasar escasez y sentir hambre, pero los que buscan {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nunca carecerán de nada bueno.
es.R: Hasta los leones jóvenes y fuertes a veces no tienen nada y pasan hambre. Pero las personas que acuden {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tendrán todo lo bueno que necesitan.

vi.L: Sư tử tơ thiếu thốn và bị đói, nhưng những người tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không thiếu một [điều] tốt nào.
vi.B: Ngay cả sư tử tơ cũng có lúc thiếu thốn và đói khát, nhưng những người tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ chẳng bao giờ thiếu điều tốt lành nào.
vi.R: Ngay cả những con sư tử tơ mạnh mẽ đôi khi cũng chẳng có gì ăn và phải đói. Nhưng những người tìm đến {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ có mọi điều tốt lành họ cần.

decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation reads "the rich". The Hebrew "young lions", the strongest of hunters, makes the same point: even the strong may go hungry. The Hebrew text is followed.

decisions.choice: those who seek the LORD: who turn to him
decisions.reason: As in verse 5.

decisions.choice: good: what is good for them
decisions.reason: Every good thing they need, not every thing they want (84:12).

source.text: לְֽכוּ־בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִ֑י יִֽרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֲלַמֶּדְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Come, children, listen to me; [the] fear of YHWH I will teach you.

en.L: Come, children, listen to me; the fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I will teach you.
en.B: Come here, children, and hear what I say; I will teach you what it means to fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Come, children, and listen. I will show you how to honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Venez, enfants, écoutez-moi ; la crainte {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, je vous l’enseignerai.
fr.B: Approchez, enfants, et écoutez ce que je dis ; je vous apprendrai ce que c’est que de craindre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Venez, enfants, et écoutez. Je vais vous montrer comment honorer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avec respect.

sw.L: Njooni, watoto, mnisikilize; kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} nitawafundisha.
sw.B: Njooni hapa, watoto, msikie ninayosema; nitawafundisha maana ya kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Njooni, watoto, msikilize. Nitawaonyesha jinsi ya kumheshimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa hofu takatifu.

es.L: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, hijos, {{plural_you:escúchenme|escuchadme}}; el temor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} enseñaré.
es.B: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}} acá, hijos, y {{plural_you:oigan|oíd}} lo que digo; {{plural_you:les|os}} enseñaré lo que significa temer {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, hijos, y {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}}. {{plural_you:Les|Os}} mostraré cómo honrar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con reverencia.

vi.L: Hãy đến, hỡi các con, hãy nghe ta; sự kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ta sẽ dạy cho các con.
vi.B: Hỡi các con, hãy lại đây và nghe ta nói; ta sẽ dạy các con biết kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là thế nào.
vi.R: Hỡi các con, hãy đến và lắng nghe. Ta sẽ chỉ cho các con cách tôn kính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

decisions.reason: As in Proverbs, a teacher calls his hearers "children" or "sons" (Proverbs 4:1). From here on the psalm teaches like the wisdom books.

decisions.choice: the fear of the LORD: reverence that shapes a life
decisions.reason: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom (Proverbs 1:7; 9:10); verses 13-15 show what it looks like.
As in 33:18.

decisions.choice: "la crainte du SEIGNEUR" (Literal), "craindre le SEIGNEUR" (Balanced), "honorer le SEIGNEUR avec respect" (Readable)
decisions.reason: As the Psalms terms note sets for this phrase. The fear of the LORD is reverence that shapes a life, not terror, which Readable makes plain.

decisions.choice: el temor del SEÑOR (L); temer al SEÑOR (B); honrar al SEÑOR con reverencia (R)
decisions.reason: The fear of the LORD is reverence that shapes a whole life. Literal and Balanced keep "temor"/"temer", the Bible's own word, and Readable says what it means, as the terms for these books settle; "miedo" would suggest simple fright.

decisions.choice: the teacher says "ta" and calls his hearers "các con"
decisions.reason: The singer now speaks as a teacher to his pupils (see the meaning decision); a Vietnamese teacher addressing "các con" calls himself "ta", in lower case, which is not God's "Ta".

source.text: מִֽי־הָ֭אִישׁ הֶחָפֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים אֹהֵ֥ב יָ֝מִ֗ים לִרְא֥וֹת טֽוֹב׃

records.literal_gloss: Who [is] the man who desires life, loving days to see good?

en.L: Who [is] {{gender:the person|the man}} who desires life, [who] loves days to see good?
en.B: Which of you wants life and longs for many days to enjoy good things?
en.R: Do you want to enjoy life? Do you want to live a long time and see good things?

fr.L: Qui [est] {{gender:la personne|l’homme}} qui désire la vie, [qui] aime les jours pour voir le bonheur ?
fr.B: Lequel d’entre vous veut la vie et désire de longs jours pour goûter le bonheur ?
fr.R: Veux-tu profiter de la vie ? Veux-tu vivre longtemps et voir de bonnes choses ?

sw.L: Ni nani mtu anayetamani uzima, [anaye]penda siku ili aone mema?
sw.B: Ni nani kati yenu anayetaka uzima na kutamani siku nyingi za kufurahia mema?
sw.R: Je, unataka kufurahia maisha? Je, unataka kuishi muda mrefu na kuona mambo mema?

es.L: ¿Quién [es] {{gender:la persona|el hombre}} que desea vida, [que] ama días para ver el bien?
es.B: ¿Quién de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} quiere vida y desea muchos días para disfrutar de cosas buenas?
es.R: ¿Quieres disfrutar de la vida? ¿Quieres vivir mucho tiempo y ver cosas buenas?

vi.L: Ai [là] người ham muốn sự sống, [là người] yêu những ngày [sống] để thấy điều tốt lành?
vi.B: Ai trong các con muốn được sống và mong có nhiều ngày để hưởng điều tốt lành?
vi.R: Các con có muốn được vui sống không? Các con có muốn sống lâu và thấy những điều tốt lành không?

decisions.reason: Peter quotes verses 13-17 to urge believers not to repay evil with evil.

decisions.choice: loves days to see good: wants a long and happy life
decisions.reason: "Days" means a long life; "to see good" is to enjoy good things (4:7).

decisions.choice: the person, with "the man" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The word ('ish) means anyone here. Balanced and Readable address the hearers directly, "you", which needs no setting.
The question is put to the hearers of verse 12.

source.text: נְצֹ֣ר לְשׁוֹנְךָ֣ מֵרָ֑ע וּ֝שְׂפָתֶ֗יךָ מִדַּבֵּ֥ר מִרְמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit.

en.L: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit.
en.B: Hold your tongue back from evil, and keep your lips from saying anything false.
en.R: Do not say evil things. Do not tell lies to trick people.

fr.L: Garde ta langue du mal et tes lèvres de dire la tromperie.
fr.B: Retiens ta langue loin du mal, et empêche tes lèvres de dire des mensonges.
fr.R: Ne dis pas de choses méchantes. Ne dis pas de mensonges pour tromper les autres.

sw.L: Uuzuie ulimi wako na mabaya na midomo yako isiseme hila.
sw.B: Uuzuie ulimi wako usiseme mabaya, na midomo yako isiseme chochote cha uongo.
sw.R: Usiseme mambo mabaya. Usiseme uongo ili kuwadanganya watu.

es.L: Guarda tu lengua del mal y tus labios de hablar engaño.
es.B: Refrena tu lengua del mal, y guarda tus labios de decir nada falso.
es.R: No digas cosas malas. No digas mentiras para engañar a la gente.

vi.L: Hãy giữ lưỡi mình khỏi điều ác và môi mình khỏi nói lời dối trá.
vi.B: Hãy kìm giữ lưỡi mình khỏi điều ác, và giữ môi mình khỏi nói điều gian dối.
vi.R: Đừng nói điều ác. Đừng nói dối để lừa gạt người khác.

decisions.reason: The tongue and lips stand for speech. The first lesson in fearing the LORD is about words.
The word (mirmah) is trickery and fraud in speech.

source.text: ס֣וּר מֵ֭רָע וַעֲשֵׂה־ט֑וֹב בַּקֵּ֖שׁ שָׁל֣וֹם וְרָדְפֵֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Turn from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.

en.L: Turn from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
en.B: Turn away from evil and do what is good; look for peace and go after it.
en.R: Stay away from evil and do good. Try hard to make peace, and never give up on it.

fr.L: Détourne-toi du mal et fais le bien ; cherche la paix et poursuis-la.
fr.B: Éloigne-toi du mal et fais ce qui est bon ; recherche la paix et cours après elle.
fr.R: Reste loin du mal et fais le bien. Fais tout pour vivre en paix avec les autres, et n’abandonne jamais.

sw.L: Geuka uache uovu na utende mema; tafuta amani na uifuatilie.
sw.B: Jiepushe na uovu na utende yaliyo mema; itafute amani na uikimbilie.
sw.R: Kaa mbali na uovu na utende mema. Jitahidi sana kuleta amani, wala usikate tamaa.

es.L: Apártate del mal y haz el bien; busca la paz y síguela.
es.B: Aléjate del mal y haz lo que es bueno; busca la paz y ve tras ella.
es.R: Mantente lejos del mal y haz el bien. Esfuérzate por hacer la paz, y nunca dejes de buscarla.

vi.L: Hãy lìa bỏ điều ác và làm điều lành; hãy tìm kiếm sự bình an và theo đuổi nó.
vi.B: Hãy tránh xa điều ác và làm điều tốt lành; hãy tìm sự bình an và đeo đuổi nó.
vi.R: Hãy tránh xa điều ác và làm điều tốt. Hãy cố gắng tạo sự hòa thuận, và đừng bao giờ bỏ cuộc.

decisions.reason: Shalom is wholeness and harmony between people, not only the absence of fighting.

decisions.choice: seek and pursue: go after it with effort
decisions.reason: Peace does not come by waiting; it must be sought and chased.

source.text: עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה אֶל־צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ֝אָזְנָ֗יו אֶל־שַׁוְעָתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] eyes of YHWH [are] toward [the] righteous, and his ears toward their cry.

en.L: The eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [are] toward the righteous, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ears toward their cry.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} keeps {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} eyes on the righteous and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ears open to their call for help.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} watches over people who do what is right. He listens when they cry for help.

fr.L: Les yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [sont] vers les justes, et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} oreilles vers leur cri.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} garde les yeux sur les justes et l’oreille ouverte à leur appel au secours.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} veille sur ceux qui font ce qui est juste. Il écoute quand ils crient au secours.

sw.L: Macho ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [yako] kwa wenye haki, na masikio {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwa kilio chao.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huyaelekeza macho {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwa wenye haki na masikio {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwa kilio chao cha kuomba msaada.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huwalinda watu wanaotenda haki. Huwasikiliza wanapolia kuomba msaada.

es.L: Los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [están] sobre los justos, y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} oídos atentos a su clamor.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tiene {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ojos puestos en los justos y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} oídos abiertos a su grito de auxilio.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} cuida a las personas que hacen lo correcto. Él escucha cuando piden ayuda a gritos.

vi.L: Mắt của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [hướng] về người công chính, và tai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [hướng] về tiếng kêu của họ.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để mắt trên người công chính và mở tai nghe tiếng họ kêu cứu.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trông chừng những người sống ngay lành. Ngài lắng nghe khi họ kêu cứu.

decisions.choice: eyes and ears: he watches and listens
decisions.reason: The LORD's eyes and ears turned toward them mean his care and his readiness to answer (33:18).

decisions.choice: their cry: a cry for help
decisions.reason: The word (shav'ah) is a call for rescue.

source.text: פְּנֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה בְּעֹ֣שֵׂי רָ֑ע לְהַכְרִ֖ית מֵאֶ֣רֶץ זִכְרָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] face of YHWH [is] against doers of evil, to cut off from [the] earth their memory.

en.L: The face of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} turns {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face against people who do evil, to erase every trace of them from the earth.
en.R: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is against people who do evil. He will destroy them so that no one on earth even remembers them.

fr.L: La face {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [est] contre ceux qui font le mal, pour retrancher de la terre leur souvenir.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} tourne {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} face contre ceux qui font le mal, pour effacer de la terre toute trace d’eux.
fr.R: Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est contre ceux qui font le mal. Il les détruira, et personne sur la terre ne se souviendra même d’eux.

sw.L: Uso wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [uko] juu ya wale watendao mabaya, ili kukatilia mbali kumbukumbu lao duniani.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huugeuza uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} dhidi ya watu watendao mabaya, ili kufuta kila alama yao duniani.
sw.R: Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yuko kinyume cha watu wanaotenda mabaya. Atawaangamiza hata hakuna mtu duniani atakayewakumbuka.

es.L: El rostro {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [está] contra los que hacen el mal, para cortar de la tierra su memoria.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vuelve {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rostro contra la gente que hace el mal, para borrar de la tierra todo rastro de ellos.
es.R: Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está en contra de la gente que hace el mal. Los destruirá para que nadie en la tierra se acuerde siquiera de ellos.

vi.L: Mặt của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [chống lại] những kẻ làm điều ác, để xóa kỷ niệm về chúng khỏi mặt đất.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} quay mặt chống lại những kẻ làm điều ác, để xóa sạch mọi dấu vết của chúng khỏi mặt đất.
vi.R: Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chống lại những kẻ làm điều ác. Ngài sẽ tiêu diệt chúng đến nỗi không ai trên đất còn nhớ đến chúng.

decisions.reason: The LORD's face, which shines on his people in blessing (Numbers 6:25), here is turned against evildoers (Leviticus 20:6).

decisions.choice: to cut off their memory: to remove them completely
decisions.reason: To have no one remember one's name was to vanish entirely (9:6-7).
Readable marks the contrast with verse 16.

source.text: צָעֲק֣וּ וַיהוָ֣ה שָׁמֵ֑עַ וּמִכָּל־צָ֝רוֹתָ֗ם הִצִּילָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: They cry out, and YHWH hears, and from all their troubles he delivers them.

en.L: They cry out, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} hears, and from all their troubles {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} delivers them.
en.B: When the righteous cry out, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} listens and frees them from every trouble they face.
en.R: When people who do right cry out for help, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} hears them. He rescues them from every one of their troubles.

fr.L: Ils crient, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} entend, et de toutes leurs détresses {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les délivre.
fr.B: Quand les justes crient, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} écoute et les libère de toutes les détresses qu’ils traversent.
fr.R: Quand ceux qui font le bien crient au secours, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les entend. Il les délivre de chacun de leurs malheurs.

sw.L: Wanalia, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anasikia, na kutoka katika taabu zao zote anawaokoa.
sw.B: Wenye haki wanapolia, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} husikiliza na kuwaweka huru kutoka katika kila taabu inayowapata.
sw.R: Watu wanaotenda haki wanapolia kuomba msaada, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huwasikia. Huwaokoa katika kila taabu yao.

es.L: Claman, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} oye, y de todas sus angustias {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los libra.
es.B: Cuando los justos claman, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escucha y los libra de cada angustia que enfrentan.
es.R: Cuando las personas que hacen el bien piden ayuda a gritos, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} las oye. Las rescata de cada uno de sus problemas.

vi.L: Họ kêu cầu, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nghe, và khỏi mọi hoạn nạn của họ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu họ.
vi.B: Khi người công chính kêu cầu, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lắng nghe và giải thoát họ khỏi mọi hoạn nạn họ gặp.
vi.R: Khi những người sống ngay lành kêu cứu, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nghe họ. Ngài giải cứu họ khỏi mọi hoạn nạn.

alternatives: the righteous cry out (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject. It refers back to the righteous of verse 16 over the evildoers of verse 17; the ancient Greek translation adds "the righteous".

decisions.choice: the righteous (B); people who do right (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the subject (m1), since "they" would point to the evildoers of verse 17.

source.text: קָר֣וֹב יְ֭הוָה לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי־לֵ֑ב וְֽאֶת־דַּכְּאֵי־ר֥וּחַ יוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: Near [is] YHWH to [the] broken of heart, and [the] crushed of spirit he saves.

en.L: Near [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to the broken of heart, and the crushed of spirit {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saves.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} stays close to those whose hearts are broken, and rescues those whose spirits are crushed.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is close to people who are hurting deep inside. He saves those who have lost all hope.

fr.L: Proche [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des brisés de cœur, et les écrasés d’esprit, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les sauve.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} reste près de ceux qui ont le cœur brisé, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sauve ceux dont l’esprit est écrasé.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est près de ceux qui ont mal au fond d’eux-mêmes. Il sauve ceux qui ont perdu tout espoir.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [yu] karibu na waliovunjika moyo, na waliopondeka roho {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} huwaokoa.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hukaa karibu na wale ambao mioyo yao imevunjika, na huwaokoa wale ambao roho zao zimepondeka.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yuko karibu na watu wenye maumivu makali moyoni. Huwaokoa wale waliokata tamaa kabisa.

es.L: Cercano [está] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a los quebrantados de corazón, y a los abatidos de espíritu {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} salva.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se mantiene cerca de los que tienen el corazón roto, y rescata a los que tienen el espíritu aplastado.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está cerca de las personas que sufren por dentro. Él salva a los que han perdido toda esperanza.

vi.L: Gần [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} với những người có lòng tan vỡ, và những người có tâm linh bị nghiền nát {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cứu.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở gần những người có lòng tan vỡ, và cứu những người có tâm hồn bị nghiền nát.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở gần những người đang đau đớn tận đáy lòng. Ngài cứu những người đã mất hết hy vọng.

decisions.reason: A broken heart is grief and sorrow, often with humility before God (51:19; Isaiah 61:1).

decisions.choice: crushed of spirit: without strength or hope
decisions.reason: The spirit is a person's inner life and courage; crushed, it has nothing left (Isaiah 57:15).
Readable says what the picture means (m2).

source.text: רַ֭בּוֹת רָע֣וֹת צַדִּ֑יק וּ֝מִכֻּלָּ֗ם יַצִּילֶ֥נּוּ יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Many [are the] troubles of [the] righteous, but from all of them YHWH delivers him.

en.L: Many [are] the troubles of [a] righteous [person], but from them all {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} delivers {{gender:them|him}}.
en.B: A righteous person faces many troubles, but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} brings {{gender:them|him}} safely through every one.
en.R: People who do right may have many troubles. But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} saves them from every one.

fr.L: Nombreux [sont] les malheurs du juste, mais de tous {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le délivre.
fr.B: Le juste connaît bien des malheurs, mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le fait passer à travers chacun d’eux.
fr.R: Ceux qui font le bien peuvent avoir beaucoup de malheurs. Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les sauve de chacun d’eux.

sw.L: Taabu za mwenye haki [ni] nyingi, lakini kutoka katika hizo zote {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} humwokoa.
sw.B: Mwenye haki hukutana na taabu nyingi, lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} humvusha salama katika kila moja.
sw.R: Watu wanaotenda haki wanaweza kuwa na taabu nyingi. Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huwaokoa katika kila moja.

es.L: Muchas [son] las aflicciones del justo, pero de todas ellas lo libra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: La persona justa enfrenta muchas aflicciones, pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} la saca a salvo de cada una.
es.R: Las personas que hacen el bien pueden tener muchos problemas. Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} las salva de cada uno.

vi.L: Nhiều [là] hoạn nạn của người công chính, nhưng khỏi tất cả những điều ấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giải cứu người.
vi.B: Người công chính gặp nhiều hoạn nạn, nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đưa người ấy vượt qua bình an mọi hoạn nạn.
vi.R: Những người sống ngay lành có thể gặp nhiều hoạn nạn. Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cứu họ khỏi mọi hoạn nạn ấy.

decisions.choice: many troubles: the righteous are not spared trouble
decisions.reason: The psalm does not promise a life free of trouble but rescue out of it.
The word is singular, a righteous person; verse 21 goes on speaking of him.
The righteous person is anyone who lives this way (m2). Literal and Balanced keep the singular because verse 21 speaks of one person's bones (see the decision there); Readable makes it plural.

source.text: שֹׁמֵ֥ר כָּל־עַצְמוֹתָ֑יו אַחַ֥ת מֵ֝הֵ֗נָּה לֹ֣א נִשְׁבָּֽרָה׃

records.literal_gloss: [He is] keeping all his bones; one of them is not broken.

en.L: [He] keeps all {{gender:their|his}} bones; not one of them is broken.
en.B: He watches over {{gender:their|his}} whole body; not a single bone will be broken.
en.R: He protects their bodies. Not even one of their bones will be broken.

fr.L: [Il] garde tous ses os ; pas un d’entre eux n’est brisé.
fr.B: Il veille sur tout son corps ; pas un seul de ses os ne sera brisé.
fr.R: Il protège leur corps. Pas un seul de leurs os ne sera cassé.

sw.L: [Yeye] huilinda mifupa yake yote; hata mmoja wa hiyo hauvunjiki.
sw.B: Huulinda mwili wake wote; hakuna hata mfupa mmoja utakaovunjika.
sw.R: Huilinda miili yao. Hakuna hata mfupa wao mmoja utakaovunjika.

es.L: [Él] guarda todos sus huesos; ni uno de ellos es quebrado.
es.B: Él cuida todo su cuerpo; no se le romperá ni un solo hueso.
es.R: Él protege sus cuerpos. No se les romperá ni uno de sus huesos.

vi.L: [Ngài] gìn giữ hết thảy xương cốt người; không một cái nào trong chúng bị gãy.
vi.B: Ngài gìn giữ cả thân thể người; không một cái xương nào bị gãy.
vi.R: Ngài che chở thân thể họ. Không một cái xương nào của họ bị gãy.

decisions.choice: all his bones: his whole body, his life
decisions.reason: As in 32:3, the bones stand for the whole person; the LORD keeps him from harm.

decisions.choice: not one of them broken: John 19:36
decisions.reason: John sees this line fulfilled when the soldiers did not break Jesus' legs (John 19:36), together with the rule for the Passover lamb (Exodus 12:46).
As in verse 20.

source.text: תְּמוֹתֵ֣ת רָשָׁ֣ע רָעָ֑ה וְשֹׂנְאֵ֖י צַדִּ֣יק יֶאְשָֽׁמוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Evil will kill [the] wicked, and those hating [the] righteous will be held guilty.

en.L: Evil will put [the] wicked to death, and those who hate [the] righteous will be held guilty.
en.B: The wicked will be killed by their own evil; whoever hates the righteous will bear the guilt.
en.R: The evil that wicked people do will destroy them. People who hate those who do right will be punished.

fr.L: Le mal fera mourir [le] méchant, et ceux qui haïssent [le] juste seront tenus pour coupables.
fr.B: Le méchant sera tué par sa propre méchanceté ; quiconque hait le juste en portera la faute.
fr.R: Le mal que font les méchants les détruira. Ceux qui détestent les gens qui font le bien seront punis.

sw.L: Uovu utamwua mwovu, na wale wanaomchukia mwenye haki watahesabiwa kuwa na hatia.
sw.B: Waovu watauawa na uovu wao wenyewe; yeyote anayemchukia mwenye haki atabeba hatia.
sw.R: Maovu wanayotenda watu waovu yatawaangamiza. Watu wanaowachukia wale wanaotenda haki wataadhibiwa.

es.L: El mal dará muerte al malvado, y los que aborrecen al justo serán declarados culpables.
es.B: Los malvados morirán por su propia maldad; quien odia al justo cargará con la culpa.
es.R: El mal que hacen los malvados los destruirá. Los que odian a quienes hacen el bien serán castigados.

vi.L: Điều ác sẽ giết chết kẻ ác, và những kẻ ghét người công chính sẽ bị kể là có tội.
vi.B: Kẻ ác sẽ bị chính điều ác của mình giết chết; ai ghét người công chính sẽ phải mang tội.
vi.R: Điều ác mà kẻ ác làm sẽ hủy diệt chúng. Những ai ghét người sống ngay lành sẽ bị trừng phạt.

decisions.choice: evil: their own wickedness, or disaster
decisions.reason: The word (ra'ah) can mean evil done or evil suffered; either way the wicked are destroyed by the evil they chose (7:16-17).

decisions.choice: be held guilty: bear the penalty of guilt
decisions.reason: The verb ('asham) means to be guilty and to suffer for it. Verse 23 says the opposite of those who shelter in the LORD.

records.literal_gloss: YHWH redeems [the] soul of his servants, and all who take refuge in him will not be held guilty.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} redeems the soul of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants, and all who take refuge in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} will not be held guilty.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} ransoms the lives of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants; none who make {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} their refuge will bear guilt.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} sets {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants free and saves their lives. People who run to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} for safety will not be punished.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} rachète l’âme de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} esclaves, et tous ceux qui se réfugient en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ne seront pas tenus pour coupables.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} paie la rançon de la vie de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs ; aucun de ceux qui font de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} leur refuge ne portera de faute.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} libère {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs et sauve leur vie. Ceux qui courent vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} pour être à l’abri ne seront pas punis.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huikomboa nafsi ya watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, na wote wanaomkimbilia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} hawatahesabiwa kuwa na hatia.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huyakomboa maisha ya watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; hakuna hata mmoja anayemfanya {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} kuwa kimbilio lake atakayebeba hatia.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huwaweka huru watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na kuyaokoa maisha yao. Watu wanaomkimbilia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ili wawe salama hawataadhibiwa.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} redime el alma de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos, y todos los que se refugian en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} no serán declarados culpables.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} rescata la vida de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos; ninguno de los que hacen de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} su refugio cargará con culpa.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} libera a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos y les salva la vida. Las personas que corren a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} para estar a salvo no serán castigadas.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chuộc linh hồn của các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và hết thảy những ai ẩn náu nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không bị kể là có tội.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chuộc mạng sống các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; không một ai lấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm nơi ẩn náu sẽ phải mang tội.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giải thoát các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và cứu mạng sống họ. Những người chạy đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để được an toàn sẽ không bị trừng phạt.

decisions.choice: an extra line after the alphabet
decisions.reason: The alphabet ends with verse 22; this verse, beginning with the letter pe, rounds off the poem, as 25:22 does.
The verb (padah) means to set free by paying a price, and is used of God freeing his people (Deuteronomy 7:8).
As in 33:19.

decisions.choice: "esclaves" at Literal, "serviteurs" at Balanced and Readable, for ʿeved when others are spoken of as God’s servants, for the whole block
decisions.reason: As the Psalms note sets for ʿeved: Literal shows that the word is the one for a slave, someone who belongs wholly to a master; the other levels say "serviteurs". Only the psalmist’s own "ton serviteur" in prayer keeps "serviteur" at every level (27:9).
